target_customer: Revenue teams: sales, presales and revenue operations leaders at B2B companies
problem: Getting the right internal stakeholders into a deal at the right time is uncoordinated across disjointed tools, causing delays and slippage.
business_model: B2B SaaS for sales teams, integrated with CRM and other tools
product_category: Team selling and sales collaboration software

competitors.name: Troops.ai
competitors.what: Slack-based sales account coordination and collaboration
competitors.funding_then: $12M Series B with Slack Fund participation

competitors.name: Tact
competitors.what: AI sales assistant with deal rooms for coordinating sellers and teams
competitors.traction_then: Operating CRM assistant for Salesforce users
competitors.funding_then: $15M round Dec 2016, about $57M total per a later summary

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow and integration SaaS with CRM connectors is standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with CRM and collaboration tools create modest lock-in, but Salesforce and Slack could add features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source documents incumbent action against Prelay.

market_need_then: The company states revenue teams struggle to involve presales and stakeholders, causing slippage; funded rivals Troops and Vivun raised in 2019, showing investor interest.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is easily confused with Relay.app and similar names; no brand evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Prelay was a 16 person YC W20 team selling software and listed SV Angel, Liquid2 and executives from Box, Dropbox, Palantir, SAP and Microsoft as backers. The directory now lists it Inactive but no shutdown notice, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. Funded rivals such as Troops.ai and Tact occupied the same space.
notes: prelay.com returned 503. CB Insights reports 500K total over 4 rounds with the latest a seed dated 2021-01-01; its investor list differs from the YC page (YC page names SV Angel, CB Insights names General Catalyst and XYZ). Round amount unknown; rests on a single database. Tact source is 2016, older than the batch but a incumbent as of founding. The Vivun and Tact collaboration products are adjacent, not identical.
